content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a change in behavior where the virtio balloon driver switched from using an Out Of Memory (OOM) handler to a shrinker for memory deflation. This led to a situation where the balloon driver would inflate memory while the system was under memory pressure, causing a busy no-op where the balloon would allocate memory that was then immediately reclaimed, resulting in inefficient memory management and prolonged inflation times. The patch reinstates the use of the OOM handler for deflation when the VIRTIO_BALLOON_F_DEFLATE_ON_OOM feature is enabled, ensuring that deflation occurs only after other memory reclamation methods have failed.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: -unsigned long leak_balloon_pages(struct virtio_balloon *vb, unsigned long pages_to_free)
-unsigned long shrink_balloon_pages(struct virtio_balloon *vb, unsigned long pages_to_free)
